Split PDF by Category

Scan a PDF for repeating labels (like branch codes or account types) and split pages into one PDF per category.

1. Upload a PDF

Drag and drop, or choose a file
DTS scans each page's text for short recurring labels (a branch code, account type, or any tag) you can split by.
DUES ACCOUNTS.pdf2.05 MB
Scanned 586 page(s). Pick categories below, then press "Scan pages".

2. Choose categories to split by

Labels detected on some but not all pages — tap the ones that represent your real categories. Boilerplate text that appears on every page is filtered out automatically.
